status: Independently expected synthetic actual-API scenarios, not executed product evidence
implementationDependency: Reviewed and merged #779, then copy/register fixtures and bind independent physical reader before actual route baseline

cases.trigger: Store the three bank parts out of order, checking each original part receipt and cold physical bytes before finalise
cases.readback: Exact complete record with 1,048,704 ASCII P characters, quantity 37.25, original producer, nanosecond times and opaque Omega fields; unchanged nonempty legacy card

cases.trigger: Store only parts 0 and 2, actually terminate/restart the isolated server, then supply the complete three-part finalise declaration
cases.resume: Uploading the missing original part permits one complete commit and original receipt

cases.trigger: Repeat an original part across restart, then send changed valid bytes/digest at the same index and changed immutable declaration metadata
cases.duplicate: Exactly original part receipt, one physical part and one original whole-object reservation; original createdAt/expiresAt unchanged
cases.unchanged: Original physical bytes/hash/declaration, no raw history/frontier/outbox

cases.trigger: After all valid part receipts, independently alter one physically stored byte without changing persisted metadata or the finalise declaration
cases.requiredActivation: Actual cold byte differs at the independently selected offset and its recomputed digest differs from the original
cases.unchanged: No complete record/tombstone/receipt/frontier/outbox; do not overwrite corruption with an empty object

cases.trigger: Stage structurally valid parts that all declare a wrong whole-object digest, then finalise their matching dense manifest
cases.unchanged: No native effects or durable receipt

cases.trigger: Initial sequence 2 and used sequence/different batch identity are offered before any new part reservation
cases.unchanged: No new reservation/physical part/receipt/frontier/outbox; existing committed history remains exact

cases.trigger: Wrong source/body binding, stale generation/epoch headers, widened category, revoked connector, and lifecycle transition while the actual body is held
cases.unchanged: No part save/reservation/history/frontier/outbox after refusal; server derives authority from live credential

cases.trigger: Original frame exceeds 1 MiB, hard declaration exceeds 64 MiB/128 parts, or explicitly negotiated object bound is narrower
cases.unchanged: No new staged allocation or native effects; ordinary batch frames remain capped at 1 MiB

cases.trigger: Reserve a first object, repeat it across restart, then independently paired stream attempts another declaration beyond a narrowed aggregate byte cap
cases.unchanged: One original reservation counted once, original physical part unchanged, no second reservation/part/native effects
cases.resume: After first reservation expires and actual cleanup releases it, the second unchanged declaration can stage

cases.trigger: Complete physically valid objects reconstruct an unsupported serializer, multiple upserts, duplicate JSON member, unsafe numeric Int64 or invalid UTF-8
cases.unchanged: No native record/tombstone/receipt/frontier/outbox; parser never repairs UTF-8, drops fields or parses through Number

cases.trigger: Base64 part boundary bisects the two UTF-8 bytes of Omega inside an otherwise valid complete payload
cases.readback: Exact original whole UTF-8/scalar record and digest; individual parts are raw bytes and must not be separately decoded/repaired

cases.trigger: Receive a valid finalise response with req() but deliberately ignore its receipt, independently cold-read the complete first transaction before retry, then restart after staging cleanup; actual connection loss remains M15
cases.result: Identical finalise returns the exact original full durable receipt with no added effects or reservation
cases.unchanged: Exact complete raw record/tombstones/receipt/frontier/outbox and compact original declaration

cases.trigger: After original finalise and physical staging purge, a later ordinary batch corrects/deletes the raw record; restart and retry the original finalise
cases.result: Exact original full receipt, verified against compact original declaration and part metadata
cases.unchanged: No resurrection of corrected/deleted raw payload, no frontier rollback, no new receipt/outbox/reservation/physical part

cases.trigger: Actual finalise child death immediately before native COMMIT that inserted the complete receipt
cases.requiredActivation: Observed exact before-COMMIT marker and bounded observed process exit
cases.retry: Original physical parts remain recoverable until expiry; after restart, same finalise commits once

cases.trigger: Actual finalise child death after native COMMIT and before response/physical cleanup
cases.requiredActivation: Observed exact after-COMMIT marker and bounded observed process exit
cases.retry: Startup cleans committed physical copies/reservation; original finalise returns exact receipt without added effects

cases.trigger: Actual SQLite full/busy or late outbox/compact-declaration statement failure during finalise
cases.requiredActivation: Real native SQLite code for full/busy; late failure marker proves raw writes occurred; actual own writer remains WAL/FULL before BEGIN

tombstoneRollbackVariant.setup: Before attaching the finalise fault, ordinary sequence 1 deletes the same large-raw-only native identity; then stage the large upsert as eligible sequence 2
tombstoneRollbackVariant.failedFinalise: Exact before state remains; the upsert's in-transaction tombstone clearing is rolled back along with raw/receipt/frontier/outbox/compact declaration

cases.retry: Original staged parts and reservation remain valid until expiry; a fresh successful retry commits once

cases.trigger: Observe first stage creation/expiry, duplicate before expiry, then advance only the synthetic test staging clock across expiry; run actual healthy sweep and restart/pre-admission cleanup paths
cases.before: Identical duplicate has no expiry extension or double reservation; unexpired other object stays present
cases.unchanged: Committed raw records/tombstones/receipts/frontier/outbox and unexpired staging remain exact
cases.limits: Healthy process: at most 24 h plus 5 min; stopped/crashed process: overdue copies removed before fresh admission

containment: Use nonempty actual-issued credential/grant/session markers and verify no echo in part/finalise errors or compact logical stores/request-phase logs; instrumented output has fixed phases/counts/digests only
remainingGates: No product execution or ACK claim; #779 merge before implementation; independent physical reader and fault/clock harness binding before meaningful baseline; required local suites, actual CI, review/merge; CORE-06.R0 before personal capture; parent projector/native/release gates remain open
